verifications.claim: Costco warehouses in the United States are closed on Easter Sunday.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Costco is not open on Easter 2026. Easter Sunday is one of the seven holidays that Costco closes its U.S. warehouses.'; R2: 'On Sunday, April 5, Costco warehouses will be closed in observance of Easter.'; R3: 'Costco warehouses and gas stations will not be open on Easter Sunday this year.'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple references directly state Costco US warehouses are closed on Easter Sunday.

verifications.claim: Easter is one of the seven major federal holidays for which Costco closes all its U.S. locations to give employees a day off.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Easter Sunday is one of the seven holidays that Costco closes its U.S. warehouses.' (not 'federal'); R5: 'closed on Easter to allow employees to spend time with their families.' (similar reason, but no 'federal holidays')
verifications.reasoning: References confirm seven holidays including Easter and employee time off, but Easter is not a federal holiday and no reference calls them 'federal holidays'.

verifications.claim: Costco is typically open for regular hours on Good Friday.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'stores will be open on April 3 (Good Friday) and April 4, from 9 a.m. to 8:30 p.m. for Executive Members and from 10 a.m to 8:30 p.m. for Gold Star and Business Members.'
verifications.reasoning: R3 directly confirms open on Good Friday with hours consistent with regular business hours; no contradictions elsewhere.

verifications.claim: Costco reopens on the Monday after Easter Sunday.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'Stores will reopen on Monday, April 6, during normal business hours'
verifications.reasoning: R2 directly states reopening on Monday after Easter Sunday (April 5).
